widening_rule.queue_order: immutable proposal arrival order; no hypothetical quality ranking
widening_rule.activation: when active_cap increases, activate earliest queued proposals until active_count==active_cap

fixed_trace.event: proposals B,C,D arrive before more terminal evidence
distinct valid terminals raise N to2 then3
fixed_trace.expected: cap remains1; active={A}; B,C,D remain queued

fixed_trace.event: distinct valid terminal raises N to4
fixed_trace.expected: cap becomes2; activate B; active={A,B}; queued={C,D}
reconstruct N4, cap2, active A/B, queued C/D exactly
cap becomes3; activate C; D remains queued

ablation.unbounded_activation: At N1 immediately activates A,B,C,D, making proposal arrival rather than terminal evidence determine frontier width.
ablation.hypothetical_ranking_queue: Would consume unevaluated semantic scores and is forbidden; FIFO arrival order is intentionally evidence-neutral.
ablation.count_invalid_terminal: A duplicate/stale/uncertain event could prematurely widen the frontier without new evidence and is forbidden.

guards: only exact same-scope distinct terminal readbacks increment N
proposal creation itself never increments N
activation is deterministic at cap boundary
public semantics bind only after precommit readback
terminal credit only after exact terminal readback
scope limited to fixed frontier trace
acceptance_rule: PASS only if a public progressive-widening mechanism limits the number of expanded actions/children as a sublinear function of accumulated visits/evidence and admits additional actions as that evidence count grows, and the fixed trace passes unchanged. No MCTS optimality or tuning claim is accepted.
credit_rule: This precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal exact readback.
